title: Wrong in public
dek: I said something confidently, publicly, and wrong. So I built something whose only job is catching me next time.

title: Give him a chance
dek: Should you give this man a chance? A flowchart, dealt as cards. Answer honestly.

title: Nobody pastes the API key
dek: keydrop sends a one-time link, you type the secret once, and it lands in the keychain. Not in the chat. Not in your shell history.

title: Front pages for an audience of one
dek: Small live demos, built fast. A newspaper that's only for you, and charts that make one point.

title: Every book on the shelf, from photos
dek: Photograph the shelves, get a catalogue. The books Mo owns, whether or not he's read them.
